set.pl: Fifth St at College Ave, Racine (later 320 Fifth St): the Knights of Columbus home dedicated there in Sept 1928, on the site the council bought in Nov 1922
pinev: Racine Journal-News 13 Sep 1928 p1 places the new K. of C. home at Fifth St and College Ave; the 1931 directory gives 320 5th; geocoded house-level; r80
One wire story from the owning family: C
set.t: Urban lot, built over by the 1920s hall: look only.

tw-wi-racine-baker-cellar-hoard-1922.st: The hall was dedicated in Sept 1928. The account speaks of a 'transformation' of the building, so the old house may have been remodelled rather than razed, and the cellar may never have been dug out. No find was ever reported.
